rules: Do not replace accepted hardware merely because historical source is inconvenient.
Persist source, commands, results, report and manifest for every experiment.
Do not label model/process data as fabricated measurement.
Coherent quantum memory is not part of the current cheap GVS fabric.
Keep Local Venule -> Charge Artery -> regional reservoir -> battery/collector recovery hierarchy.
Population Confidence remains the authority for robust answers; restart/reseed mechanisms never authorize an answer.
MOS transistors are prohibited inside the v14G/v14H/v14J semantic and reasoning core candidate; v14E CMOS remains reference evidence only.
Persistent semantic memory in ordinary semantic cells belongs in sparse connection state, not stored node voltage; temporary excitation charge is allowed.
v14J connection plasticity must be reversible: useful relations may strengthen and disproven relations must be able to weaken and later strengthen again.
Repeated co-firing alone is not semantic truth; plasticity polarity must be grounded by Goal Echo, local contradiction evidence, Population Confidence, or another valid learning signal.
Ordinary SKY130 MIM is an inference-only fixed-connection floor and must never be described as a programmable learning device.
Prefer weak/strong or a small number of connection states before high-precision analog weights unless measured reasoning benefit repays precision.
Prefer connection/population redundancy over copying persistent memory hardware into every semantic cell.

Do not claim a ferroelectric memcapacitor or other two-terminal plastic device is cheaper than CMOS until programming rails, selectors, process steps, half-select disturbance, yield, endurance, retention, area and energy are counted.
Goal Echo remains part of the reasoning hypothesis: forward prompt evidence and reciprocal goal compatibility must be compared against forward-only controls.
CRRO is currently accepted only for exact modular addition in Z_420; do not call it general arithmetic.
Need-Triggered Transformation Cells select reusable transformations from current unmet state; they are not a hidden program counter.
Multiplication, factorization and other exact transformations remain open operator problems inside the broader plastic connection-memory intelligence fabric.
